name: Our Father
content:
Our Father, who art in heaven,
hallowed be Thy name.
Thy kingdom come,
Thy will be done,
on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread,
and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil.
Amen.

name: Hail Mary
content:
Hail Mary, full of grace,
the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.

name: Glory Be
content:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.

name: Apostles' Creed
content:
I believe in God, the Father Almighty,
Creator of heaven and earth.
I believe in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord,
who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
born of the Virgin Mary,
suffered under Pontius Pilate,
was crucified, died, and was buried;
He descended into hell;
on the third day He rose again from the dead;
He ascended into heaven,
and is seated at the right hand of God the Father Almighty;
from there He will come to judge the living and the dead.
I believe in the Holy Spirit,
the holy Catholic Church,
the communion of saints,
the forgiveness of sins,
the resurrection of the body,
and life everlasting. Amen.

name: Act of Contrition
content:
O my God, I am heartily sorry
for having offended Thee,
and I detest all my sins,
because of Thy just punishments,
but most of all because they offend Thee, my God,
who art all-good and deserving of all my love.
I firmly resolve, with the help of Thy grace,
to sin no more and to avoid the near occasions of sin.
Amen.

name: Morning Offering
content:
O Jesus, through the Immaculate Heart of Mary,
I offer You my prayers, works, joys and sufferings of this day
for all the intentions of Your Sacred Heart,
in union with the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass throughout the world,
in reparation for my sins,
for the intentions of all my associates,
and in particular for the intentions of the Holy Father.
Amen.

name: Evening Prayer
content:
Lord, as I come to the end of this day,
I give thanks for all the blessings You have given me.
Forgive me for the times I have failed You.
Protect me through the night,
and let me rest in Your peace.
Keep watch over those I love.
May I rise tomorrow renewed in Your grace.
Amen.

name: Hail, Holy Queen
content:
Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy,
our life, our sweetness and our hope.
To thee do we cry,
poor banished children of Eve.
To thee do we send up our sighs,
mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.
Turn then, most gracious advocate,
thine eyes of mercy toward us,
and after this our exile,
show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.
Pray for us, O holy Mother of God,
that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

name: Rosary Opening Prayer
content:
I believe in God…
(Apostles' Creed)
Our Father…
Hail Mary… (3 times, for Faith, Hope, and Charity)
Glory Be…

Announce the First Mystery.
Our Father…
10 Hail Marys…
Glory Be…
O My Jesus, forgive us our sins…

name: Fatima Prayer
content:
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins,
save us from the fires of hell.
Lead all souls to heaven,
especially those in most need of Thy mercy.
Amen.

name: Prayer to Saint Michael
content:
Saint Michael the Archangel,
defend us in battle.
Be our protection against the wickedness
and snares of the devil.
May God rebuke him, we humbly pray;
and do Thou, O Prince of the Heavenly Host,
by the power of God,
cast into hell Satan and all evil spirits
who wander through the world seeking the ruin of souls.
Amen.

name: Memorare
content:
Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary,
that never was it known
that anyone who fled to thy protection,
implored thy help, or sought thy intercession,
was left unaided.
Inspired by this confidence,
I fly unto thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother.
To thee do I come, before thee I stand,
sinful and sorrowful.
O Mother of the Word Incarnate,
despise not my petitions,
but in thy mercy hear and answer me.
Amen.

name: Anima Christi
content:
Soul of Christ, sanctify me.
Body of Christ, save me.
Blood of Christ, inebriate me.
Water from the side of Christ, wash me.
Passion of Christ, strengthen me.
O good Jesus, hear me.
Within Thy wounds, hide me.
Permit me not to be separated from Thee.
From the malicious enemy, defend me.
In the hour of my death, call me.
And bid me come to Thee,
that with Thy saints I may praise Thee
Forever and ever.
Amen.

name: Lauds — Morning Prayer
content:
Lord, open my lips.
And my mouth shall proclaim Your praise.
Glory to the Father, and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit;
as it was in the beginning, is now,
and will be for ever. Amen. Alleluia.

Hymn:
Now that the daylight fills the sky,
We lift our hearts to God on high,
That He, in all we do or say,
Would keep us free from harm today.
Amen.

name: Vespers — Evening Prayer
content:
God, come to my assistance.
Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory to the Father, and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit;
as it was in the beginning, is now,
and will be for ever. Amen.

Magnificat:
My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord,
my spirit rejoices in God my Saviour.
For He has looked with favour on His lowly servant.
From this day all generations will call me blessed;
the Almighty has done great things for me
and holy is His name.
Amen.

name: Compline — Night Prayer
content:
May the Lord Almighty grant us a restful night
and a peaceful death.
Amen.

I confess to almighty God
and to you, my brothers and sisters,
that I have greatly sinned
in my thoughts and in my words,
in what I have done and in what I have failed to do.
Through my fault, through my fault,
through my most grievous fault;
therefore I ask blessed Mary ever-Virgin,
all the Angels and Saints,
and you, my brothers and sisters,
to pray for me to the Lord our God.

name: Babamız Duası
content:
Göklerdeki Babamız,
adın kutsal kılınsın.
Egemenliğin gelsin,
Yerin üzerinde de gökteki gibi
senin istediğin olsun.
Günlük ekmeğimizi bugün bize ver.
Bize karşı günah işleyenleri
bağışladığımız gibi,
sen de bizim günahlarımızı bağışla.
Bizi ayartmaya sürükleme,
bizi kötü olandan kurtar.
Amin.

name: Selam Ey Meryem
content:
Selam ey Meryem, lütufla dolu,
Rab seninle birlikte.
Sen kadınlar arasında kutsansın
ve rahmin meyvesi İsa da kutlu olsun.
Tanrı'nın kutsal anası Meryem,
bizim için dua et,
şimdi ve ölüm saatimizde.
Amin.

name: Sabah Duası
content:
Sevgili Rabbim,
bugünkü tüm dualarımı, çalışmalarımı,
sevinçlerimi ve acılarımı Sana sunuyorum.
Bana lütuf ver ki
bugün Sana layık şekilde hizmet edebileyim.
Kalp ve ruhum Seninle olsun.
Amin.

name: Akşam Duası
content:
Sevgili Tanrım,
bu günün sonunda Sana şükrediyorum.
Bana verdiğin her nimet için teşekkür ederim.
Sana karşı geldiğim her an için
affımı diliyorum.
Geceyi huzur içinde geçirmemi sağla.
Amin.

name: Ölülere Dua
content:
Ey Rabbim, onlara sonsuz dinçlik ver,
ve ebedi ışık onları aydınlatsın.
Ruhları ve tüm ölülerin ruhları
Tanrı'nın merhametiyle huzur bulsun.
Amin.

name: Şan Olsun
content:
Şan olsun Baba'ya,
Oğul'a
ve Kutsal Ruh'a.
Ezelde olduğu gibi,
şimdi ve her zaman
ve ebediyen.
Amin.

name: Havariler İnancı
content:
Her şeye gücü yeten Baba,
göğün ve yerin yaratıcısı Tanrı'ya inanıyorum.
O'nun biricik Oğlu, Rabbimiz İsa Mesih'e inanıyorum.
O, Kutsal Ruh'tan vücut buldu,
Bakire Meryem'den doğdu.
Pontius Pilatus zamanında acı çekti,
çarmıha gerildi, öldü ve gömüldü.
Ölüler diyarına indi;
üçüncü gün ölüler arasından dirildi;
göğe yükseldi,
her şeye gücü yeten Baba Tanrı'nın sağında oturmaktadır;
oradan dirileri ve ölüleri yargılamak için yeniden gelecektir.
Kutsal Ruh'a,
kutsal Katolik Kilise'ye,
aziz cemaatine,
günahların bağışlanmasına,
bedenin dirilişine
ve sonsuz yaşama inanıyorum.
Amin.

name: Pişmanlık Duası
content:
Ey Tanrım, Seni gücendirdiğim için
yürekten pişmanım,
ve tüm günahlarımdan nefret ediyorum,
çünkü onlar adil cezanı hak ediyor,
ama en çok da Seni, tüm iyiliklerin ve
sevgiye layık olan Tanrım'ı gücendirdikleri için.
Lütfunun yardımıyla
bir daha günah işlememeye
ve günaha yaklaşan fırsatlardan kaçınmaya
kesin karar veriyorum.
Amin.

name: Selam Ey Hükümdar Ana
content:
Selam, ey kutsal Hükümdar Ana, merhamet Anası,
hayatımız, tatlılığımız ve ümidimiz, selam sana.
Sana sesleniyoruz,
Havva'nın sürgündeki evlatları.
Sana iç çekişlerimizi gönderiyoruz,
bu gözyaşı vadisinde inleyerek ve ağlayarak.
O halde, ey bizim savunucumuz,
merhamet dolu gözlerini bize çevir.
Ve bu sürgünden sonra,
rahminin kutsal meyvesi İsa'yı bize göster.
Ey şefkatli, ey sevgi dolu, ey tatlı Bakire Meryem.
Bizim için dua et, ey Tanrı'nın kutsal Anası,
Mesih'in vaatlerine layık olalım.
Amin.

name: Tespihin Başlangıç Duası
content:
İnanıyorum…
(Havariler İnancı)
Babamız…
Selam Sana Meryem… (İman, Ümit ve Sevgi için 3 kez)
Şan Olsun…

Birinci Gizemi duyurun.
Babamız…
10 Selam Sana Meryem…
Şan Olsun…
Ey İsa'm, günahlarımızı bağışla…

name: Fatima Duası
content:
Ey İsa'm, günahlarımızı bağışla,
bizi cehennem ateşinden koru.
Tüm ruhları cennete götür,
özellikle merhametine en çok ihtiyaç duyanları.
Amin.

name: Aziz Mikail Duası
content:
Başmelek Aziz Mikail,
savaşta bizi koru.
Şeytanın kötülüğüne ve tuzaklarına karşı
bize kalkan ol.
Tanrı onu azarlasın, alçakgönüllülükle dileriz;
ve sen, ey Göksel Ordular Prensi,
Tanrı'nın gücüyle,
dünyada dolaşıp ruhların yıkımını arayan
Şeytan'ı ve tüm kötü ruhları
cehenneme at.
Amin.

name: Memorare
content:
Hatırla, ey en şefkatli Bakire Meryem,
koruman altına sığınan,
yardımını dileyen ya da şefaatini arayan
hiç kimsenin yardımsız bırakılmadığını.
Bu güvenden ilham alarak,
sana koşuyorum, ey bakirelerin Bakiresi, Anam.
Sana geliyorum, önünde duruyorum,
günahkâr ve kederli.
Ey vücut bulmuş Söz'ün Anası,
yakarışlarımı hor görme,
lütfen merhametle işit ve bana cevap ver.
Amin.

name: Mesih'in Ruhu
content:
Mesih'in ruhu, beni kutsa.
Mesih'in bedeni, beni kurtar.
Mesih'in kanı, beni sarhoş et.
Mesih'in yanından akan su, beni yıka.
Mesih'in çilesi, beni güçlendir.
Ey iyi İsa, beni işit.
Yaralarının içinde, beni sakla.
Senden ayrılmama izin verme.
Hain düşmandan, beni koru.
Ölüm saatimde, beni çağır.
Ve yanına gelmemi buyur,
azizlerinle birlikte Seni övmem için
sonsuza dek.
Amin.

name: Övgüler — Sabah İbadeti
content:
Ya Rab, dudaklarımı aç.
Ve ağzım Sana övgüler duyursun.
Şan olsun Baba'ya, Oğul'a
ve Kutsal Ruh'a;
ezelde olduğu gibi, şimdi ve her zaman
ve ebediyen. Amin. Alleluya.

İlahi:
Gün ışığı gökyüzünü doldururken,
yüreklerimizi yüce Tanrı'ya kaldırıyoruz,
O'nun, yaptığımız ve söylediğimiz her şeyde,
bizi bugün kötülükten korumasını dileriz.
Amin.

name: Akşam İbadeti — Vesperler
content:
Ey Tanrım, yardımıma gel.
Ya Rab, imdadıma yetişmekte acele et.
Şan olsun Baba'ya, Oğul'a
ve Kutsal Ruh'a;
ezelde olduğu gibi, şimdi ve her zaman
ve ebediyen. Amin.

Magnificat:
Ruhum Rab'bin yüceliğini ilan eder,
yüreğim Kurtarıcım Tanrı'da sevinir.
Çünkü O, alçakgönüllü kulunun haline baktı.
Bundan böyle bütün kuşaklar beni mutlu sayacak;
kudretli Olan büyük işler yaptı benim için,
O'nun adı kutsaldır.
Amin.

name: Gece İbadeti — Komplin
content:
Her şeye gücü yeten Rab bize huzurlu bir gece
ve barış içinde bir ölüm bahşetsin.
Amin.

Her şeye gücü yeten Tanrı'ya
ve sizlere, kardeşlerime,
düşüncelerimde ve sözlerimde,
yaptıklarımda ve yapmadıklarımda
çokça günah işlediğimi itiraf ediyorum.
Benim suçumla, benim suçumla,
benim çok büyük suçumla;
bu yüzden ebediyen bakire kutsal Meryem'den,
tüm Melekler ve Azizlerden,
ve sizlerden, kardeşlerimden,
benim için Rabbimiz Tanrı'ya dua etmenizi diliyorum.

name: Padre Nuestro
content:
Padre nuestro, que estás en los cielos,
santificado sea Tu nombre.
Venga Tu reino,
hágase Tu voluntad,
así en la tierra como en el cielo.
Danos hoy nuestro pan de cada día.
Perdona nuestras ofensas,
como también nosotros perdonamos
a los que nos ofenden.
No nos dejes caer en tentación,
y líbranos del mal.
Amén.

name: Ave María
content:
Dios te salve, María,
llena eres de gracia;
el Señor es contigo.
Bendita tú eres entre todas las mujeres,
y bendito es el fruto de tu vientre, Jesús.
Santa María, Madre de Dios,
ruega por nosotros pecadores,
ahora y en la hora de nuestra muerte.
Amén.

name: Oración de la Mañana
content:
Oh Dios mío,
te ofrezco este día,
todas mis oraciones, pensamientos,
acciones y sufrimientos en unión
con el Sagrado Corazón de Jesús.
Quiero amar a mi prójimo
como me amas Tú.
Amén.

name: Gloria al Padre
content:
Gloria al Padre,
y al Hijo,
y al Espíritu Santo.
Como era en el principio,
ahora y siempre,
por los siglos de los siglos.
Amén.

name: Pai Nosso
content:
Pai nosso que estais no céu,
santificado seja o vosso nome.
Venha a nós o vosso reino.
Seja feita a vossa vontade,
assim na terra como no céu.
O pão nosso de cada dia nos dai hoje.
Perdoai-nos as nossas ofensas,
assim como nós perdoamos a quem nos tem ofendido.
E não nos deixeis cair em tentação,
mas livrai-nos do mal.
Amém.

name: Ave Maria
content:
Ave Maria, cheia de graça,
o Senhor é convosco.
Bendita sois vós entre as mulheres,
e bendito é o fruto do vosso ventre, Jesus.
Santa Maria, Mãe de Deus,
rogai por nós pecadores,
agora e na hora de nossa morte.
Amém.

name: Glória ao Pai
content:
Glória ao Pai,
ao Filho
e ao Espírito Santo.
Como era no princípio,
agora e sempre,
por todos os séculos dos séculos.
Amém.

name: The Way of the Cross
content:
1. Jesus is condemned to death.
2. Jesus carries His cross.
3. Jesus falls the first time.
4. Jesus meets His Mother.
5. Simon of Cyrene helps Jesus carry the cross.
6. Veronica wipes the face of Jesus.
7. Jesus falls the second time.
8. Jesus meets the women of Jerusalem.
9. Jesus falls the third time.
10. Jesus is stripped of His garments.
11. Jesus is nailed to the cross.
12. Jesus dies on the cross.
13. Jesus is taken down from the cross.
14. Jesus is laid in the tomb.

We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You,
because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.

name: Divine Mercy Chaplet
content:
Eternal Father, I offer You the Body and Blood,
Soul and Divinity of Your dearly beloved Son,
Our Lord Jesus Christ,
in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.

(On the 10 small beads, repeat 10 times:)
For the sake of His sorrowful Passion,
have mercy on us and on the whole world.

(Conclude, three times:)
Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One,
have mercy on us and on the whole world.

name: The Angelus
content:
V. The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary,
R. And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.
Hail Mary…

V. Behold the handmaid of the Lord,
R. Be it done unto me according to Thy word.
Hail Mary…

V. And the Word was made flesh,
R. And dwelt among us.
Hail Mary…

V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God,
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Let us pray:
Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord,
Thy grace into our hearts,
that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, Thy Son,
was made known by the message of an angel,
may by His Passion and Cross
be brought to the glory of His Resurrection.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
Amen.

name: Regina Coeli
content:
Queen of Heaven, rejoice, alleluia.
For He whom you did merit to bear, alleluia,
Has risen, as He said, alleluia.
Pray for us to God, alleluia.

Rejoice and be glad, O Virgin Mary, alleluia.
For the Lord has truly risen, alleluia.

Let us pray:
O God, who through the resurrection of Your Son,
our Lord Jesus Christ,
did vouchsafe to give joy to the world;
grant, we beseech You,
that through His Mother, the Virgin Mary,
we may obtain the joys of everlasting life.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
Amen.

name: Çarmıh Yolu
content:
1. İsa ölüme mahkûm edilir.
2. İsa çarmıhını yüklenir.
3. İsa ilk kez düşer.
4. İsa, Annesi'yle karşılaşır.
5. Simon Kirineli, çarmıhı taşımasına yardım eder.
6. Veronika, İsa'nın yüzünü siler.
7. İsa ikinci kez düşer.
8. İsa, Kudüs kadınlarıyla karşılaşır.
9. İsa üçüncü kez düşer.
10. İsa'nın giysileri soyulur.
11. İsa çarmıha çivilenir.
12. İsa çarmıhta ölür.
13. İsa çarmıhtan indirilir.
14. İsa mezara konulur.

Sana tapıyoruz, ey Mesih, ve Seni kutsuyoruz,
çünkü kutsal Çarmıhınla dünyayı kurtardın.

name: İlahi Merhamet Koroncası
content:
Ebedi Baba, Sana sunuyorum
çok sevgili Oğlun Rabbimiz İsa Mesih'in
Bedenini ve Kanını, Ruhunu ve Tanrılığını,
günahlarımızın ve tüm dünyanın günahlarının kefareti için.

(10 küçük tanede, 10 kez tekrarlayın:)
O'nun acılı Çilesi hatırına,
bize ve tüm dünyaya merhamet et.

(Üç kez tekrarlayarak bitirin:)
Kutsal Tanrı, Kutsal Kudretli, Kutsal Ölümsüz,
bize ve tüm dünyaya merhamet et.

name: Angelus (Rab'bin Melek Duası)
content:
Rab'bin meleği Meryem'e müjdeledi,
ve o, Kutsal Ruh'tan gebe kaldı.
Selam Sana Meryem…

İşte Rab'bin hizmetçisiyim,
bana sözün gerçekleşsin.
Selam Sana Meryem…

Ve Söz insan oldu,
ve aramızda yaşadı.
Selam Sana Meryem…

Bizim için dua et, ey Tanrı'nın kutsal Anası,
Mesih'in vaatlerine layık olalım.

Dua edelim:
Ya Rab, sana yalvarıyoruz,
lütfunu yüreklerimize dök,
biz ki Oğlun Mesih'in bedenlenişini
bir meleğin haberiyle öğrendik,
O'nun Çilesi ve Çarmıhı aracılığıyla
Dirilişinin görkemine erişelim.
Aynı Mesih Rabbimiz aracılığıyla.
Amin.

name: Regina Coeli (Göklerin Kraliçesi)
content:
Göklerin Kraliçesi, sevin, alleluya.
Çünkü taşımaya layık görüldüğün O, alleluya,
söylediği gibi dirildi, alleluya.
Bizim için Tanrı'ya dua et, alleluya.

Sevin ve mutlu ol, ey Bakire Meryem, alleluya.
Çünkü Rab gerçekten dirildi, alleluya.

Dua edelim:
Ey Tanrım, Oğlun Rabbimiz İsa Mesih'in
dirilişiyle dünyaya sevinç bahşeden,
sana yalvarıyoruz,
Anası Bakire Meryem aracılığıyla
sonsuz yaşamın sevincine erişelim.
Aynı Mesih Rabbimiz aracılığıyla.
Amin.

name: Vater Unser
content:
Vater unser im Himmel,
geheiligt werde dein Name.
Dein Reich komme.
Dein Wille geschehe,
wie im Himmel so auf Erden.
Unser tägliches Brot gib uns heute.
Und vergib uns unsere Schuld,
wie auch wir vergeben unsern Schuldigern.
Und führe uns nicht in Versuchung,
sondern erlöse uns von dem Bösen.
Amen.

name: Gegrüßet seist du, Maria
content:
Gegrüßet seist du, Maria,
voll der Gnade,
der Herr ist mit dir.
Du bist gebenedeit unter den Frauen,
und gebenedeit ist die Frucht
deines Leibes, Jesus.
Heilige Maria, Mutter Gottes,
bitte für uns Sünder
jetzt und in der Stunde unseres Todes.
Amen.

name: Ehre sei dem Vater
content:
Ehre sei dem Vater
und dem Sohn
und dem Heiligen Geist,
wie es war im Anfang,
jetzt und immerdar
und von Ewigkeit zu Ewigkeit.
Amen.

name: Morgengebet
content:
Herr, mein Gott,
ch danke dir, dass du mich diese Nacht
behütet hast.
Ich bitte dich, beschütze mich auch heute,
lass mich nach deinem Willen leben
und führe mich auf dem Weg zum ewigen Leben.
Amen.

name: Abendgebet
content:
Herr, ich danke dir für diesen Tag.
Vergib mir alle Sünden,
die ich heute begangen habe,
im Denken, Reden und Handeln.
Behüte mich in dieser Nacht
und lass mich morgen neu beginnen.
Amen.

name: Notre Père
content:
Notre Père, qui es aux cieux,
que ton nom soit sanctifié,
que ton règne vienne,
que ta volonté soit faite
sur la terre comme au ciel.
Donne-nous aujourd'hui notre pain de ce jour.
Pardonne-nous nos offenses,
comme nous pardonnons aussi
à ceux qui nous ont offensés.
Et ne nous soumets pas à la tentation,
mais délivre-nous du mal.
Amen.

name: Je vous salue, Marie
content:
Je vous salue, Marie,
pleine de grâce,
le Seigneur est avec vous.
Vous êtes bénie entre toutes les femmes,
et Jésus, le fruit de vos entrailles,
est béni.
Sainte Marie, Mère de Dieu,
priez pour nous, pauvres pécheurs,
maintenant et à l'heure de notre mort.
Amen.

name: Gloire au Père
content:
Gloire au Père,
et au Fils,
et au Saint-Esprit.
Comme il était au commencement,
maintenant et toujours,
dans les siècles des siècles.
Amen.

name: Prière du Matin
content:
Mon Dieu, je vous offre cette journée.
Acceptez mes prières, mes travaux,
mes joies et mes peines,
en union avec votre Cœur Sacré.
Guide mes pas sur le chemin
qui mène à la vie éternelle.
Amen.

name: Padre Nostro
content:
Padre nostro, che sei nei cieli,
sia santificato il tuo nome.
Venga il tuo regno.
Sia fatta la tua volontà,
come in cielo così in terra.
Dacci oggi il nostro pane quotidiano.
E rimetti a noi i nostri debiti,
come noi li rimettiamo ai nostri debitori.
E non ci indurre in tentazione,
ma liberaci dal male.
Amen.

name: Ave Maria
content:
Ave, o Maria, piena di grazia,
il Signore è con te.
Tu sei benedetta fra le donne
e benedetto è il frutto
del tuo seno, Gesù.
Santa Maria, Madre di Dio,
prega per noi peccatori,
adesso e nell'ora della nostra morte.
Amen.

name: Gloria al Padre
content:
Gloria al Padre,
al Figlio
ed allo Spirito Santo.
Come era in principio,
or è e sempre sarà,
nei secoli dei secoli.
Amen.

name: Ojcze Nasz
content:
Ojcze nasz, któryś jest w niebie,
święć się imię Twoje.
Przyjdź królestwo Twoje,
bądź wola Twoja jako w niebie,
tak i na ziemi.
Chleba naszego powszedniego
daj nam dzisiaj.
I odpuść nam nasze winy,
jako i my odpuszczamy naszym winowajcom.
I nie wódź nas na pokuszenie,
ale nas zbaw ode złego.
Amen.

name: Zdrowaś Mario
content:
Zdrowaś Maryjo, łaski pełna,
Pan z Tobą.
Błogosławionaś Ty między niewiastami
i błogosławiony owoc żywota Twojego, Jezus.
Święta Maryjo, Matko Boża,
módl się za nami grzesznymi
teraz i w godzinę śmierci naszej.
Amen.

name: Chwała Ojcu
content:
Chwała Ojcu i Synowi,
i Duchowi Świętemu.
Jak była na początku,
teraz i zawsze,
i na wieki wieków.
Amen.

name: Отче Наш
content:
Отче наш, що єси на небесах,
хай святиться ім'я Твоє,
хай прийде Царство Твоє,
хай буде воля Твоя,
як на небі, так і на землі.
Хліб наш насущний дай нам сьогодні,
і прости нам провини наші,
як і ми прощаємо винуватцям нашим,
і не введи нас у спокусу,
але визволи нас від лукавого.
Аминь.

name: Радуйся, Маріє
content:
Радуйся, Маріє, благодаті повна,
Господь з Тобою.
Благословенна Ти між жінками
і благословенний плід утроби Твоєї, Ісус.
Свята Маріє, Мати Божа,
молися за нас грішних
нині і в годину смерті нашої.
Аминь.

name: Отче Наш
Богородице Дево, радуйся
content:
Богородице Дево, радуйся,
благодатная Марие, Господь с Тобою;
благословена Ты в женах,
и благословен Плод чрева Твоего,
яко Спаса родила еси душ наших.
Аминь.

name: Молитва утренняя
content:
Господи Боже мой,
благодарю Тебя за этот день.
Помоги мне прожить его
по Твоей воле,
сохранить мир в сердце
и служить ближним с любовью.
Аминь.

name: Tatăl Nostru
content:
Tatăl nostru, care ești în ceruri,
sfințească-se numele Tău.
Vie împărăția Ta.
Facă-se voia Ta,
precum în cer, așa și pe pământ.
Pâinea noastră cea de toate zilele
dă-ne-o nouă astăzi.
Și ne iartă nouă greșelile noastre,
precum și noi iertăm
greșiților noștri.
Și nu ne duce pe noi în ispită,
ci ne izbăvește de cel rău.
Amin.

name: Bucură-te, Marie
content:
Bucură-te, Marie,
cela ce ești plină de har,
Domnul este cu tine.
Binecuvântată ești tu între femei
și binecuvântat este rodul pântecelui tău, Iisus.
Sfântă Marie, Maica lui Dumnezeu,
roagă-te pentru noi, păcătoșii,
acum și în ceasul morții noastre.
Amin.

name: Onze Vader
content:
Onze Vader, die in de hemelen zijt,
uw naam worde geheiligd.
Uw koninkrijk kome.
Uw wil geschiede,
gelijk in de hemel, alzo ook op de aarde.
Geef ons heden ons dagelijks brood.
En vergeef ons onze schulden,
gelijk ook wij vergeven aan onze schuldenaren.
En leid ons niet in verzoeking,
maar verlos ons van de boze.
Amen.

name: Wees gegroet, Maria
content:
Wees gegroet, Maria,
vol van genade.
De Heer is met U.
Gij zijt de gezegende onder de vrouwen
en gezegend is Jezus,
de vrucht van uw schoot.
Heilige Maria, Moeder van God,
bid voor ons zondaars,
nu en in het uur van onze dood.
Amen.

name: Πάτερ ἡμῶν
content:
Πάτερ ἡμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς,
ἁγιασθήτω τὸ ὄνομά σου.
ἐλθέτω ἡ βασιλεία σου.
γενηθήτω τὸ θέλημά σου,
ὡς ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον
δὸς ἡμῖν σήμερον.
καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰ ὀφειλήματα ἡμῶν,
ὡς καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν
τοῖς ὀφειλέταις ἡμῶν.
καὶ μὴ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς εἰς πειρασμόν,
ἀλλὰ ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.
Αμήν.

name: Χαῖρε Μαρία
content:
Χαῖρε Μαρία, κεχαριτωμένη,
ο Κύριος μετά Σου.
Ευλογημένη Συ εν γυναιξί
και ευλογημένος ο καρπός
της κοιλίας Σου, Ιησούς.
Αγία Μαρία, Μήτερ Θεού,
πρέσβευε υπέρ ημών των αμαρτωλών,
νυν και εν τη ώρα του θανάτου ημών.
Αμήν.

name: Ama Namin
content:
Ama namin, sumasalangit Ka,
sambahin ang ngalan Mo.
mapasaamin ang kaharian Mo.
sundin ang loob Mo
dito sa lupa para nang sa langit.
bigyan Mo kami ngayon ng aming kakanin sa araw-araw.
at patawarin Mo kami sa aming mga sala,
para nang pagpapatawad namin
sa nagkakasala sa amin.
at huwag Mo kaming ipahintulot
sa tukso.
at iadya Mo kami sa lahat ng masama.
Amen.

name: Aba, Ginoong Maria
content:
Aba, Ginoong Maria, napupuno ka ng grasya,
ang Panginoon ay sumasaiyo.
Ikaw ay pinagpala sa babaeng lahat
at pinagpala naman ang iyong anak na si Hesus.
Santang Maria, Ina ng Diyos,
ipanalangin mo kaming makasalanan
ngayon at kung kami'y mamamatay.
Amen.

name: Luwalhati sa Ama
content:
Luwalhati sa Ama,
at sa Anak,
at sa Espiritu Santo.
Kapara ng sa simula,
gayon at magpakailanman,
magpasawalang hanggan.
Amen.

name: 天主经
content:
我们在天上的父，
愿人都尊你的名为圣，
愿你的国降临，
愿你的旨意行在地上，
如同行在天上。
我们日用的饮食，今日赐给我们。
免我们的债，
如同我们免了人的债。
不叫我们遇见试探，
救我们脱离凶恶。
阿们。

name: 万福玛利亚
content:
万福玛利亚，
你充满圣宠，
主与你同在，
你在女人中受赞颂，
你的亲子耶稣同受赞颂。
天主圣母玛利亚，
求你现在和我们临终时，
为我们罪人祈求天主。
阿们。

name: 光荣经
content:
愿光荣归于父，
及子，
及圣神，
起初如何，
今日亦然，
直到永远，
世世代代，
阿们。

name: हमारे पिता
content:
हे हमारे पिता, जो स्वर्ग में है,
तेरा नाम पवित्र माना जाए।
तेरा राज्य आए।
तेरी इच्छा जैसे स्वर्ग में,
वैसे पृथ्वी पर भी पूरी हो।
हमारी दिनभर की रोटी आज हमें दे।
हमारे अपराध क्षमा कर,
जैसे हम अपने अपराधियों को क्षमा करते हैं।
हमें परीक्षा में मत डाल,
बल्कि बुराई से बचा।
आमीन।

name: प्रणाम, मरियम
content:
प्रणाम, मरियम, अनुग्रह से परिपूर्ण,
प्रभु तुम्हारे साथ है।
तुम स्त्रियों में धन्य हो,
और धन्य है तुम्हारे गर्भ का फल ईसा।
पवित्र मरियम, ईश्वर की माँ,
हमारे लिए प्रार्थना कर,
अभी और मृत्यु की घड़ी में।
आमीन।

name: 주님의 기도
content:
하늘에 계신 우리 아버지,
아버지의 이름이 거룩히 빛나시며,
아버지의 나라가 오시며,
아버지의 뜻이 하늘에서와 같이
땅에서도 이루어지소서.
오늘 저희에게 일용할 양식을 주시고,
저희에게 잘못한 이를
저희가 용서하오니,
저희 죄를 용서하시고,
저희를 유혹에 빠지지 않게 하시고,
악에서 구하소서.
아멘.

name: 성모송
content:
은총이 가득하신 마리아님,
기뻐하소서.
주님께서 함께 계시니,
여인 중에 복되시며
태중의 아들 예수님 또한 복되시나이다.
천주의 성모 마리아님,
이제와 저희 죽을 때에
저희 죄인을 위하여 빌어주소서.
아멘.

name: 영광송
content:
영광이 성부와 성자와 성령께,
처음과 같이 이제와 항상
영원히. 아멘.

name: Bapa Kami
content:
Bapa kami yang ada di surga,
dikuduskanlah nama-Mu.
Datanglah kerajaan-Mu.
Jadilah kehendak-Mu
di bumi seperti di surga.
Berikanlah kami pada hari ini
makanan kami yang secukupnya.
Ampunilah kami akan kesalahan kami,
seperti kami juga mengampuni
orang yang bersalah kepada kami.
Janganlah membawa kami ke dalam pencobaan,
tetapi lepaskanlah kami dari yang jahat.
Amen.

name: Salam Maria
content:
Salam Maria, penuh rahmat,
Tuhan sertamu.
Engkau terberkati di antara wanita
dan terberkati buah tubuhmu, Yesus.
Santa Maria, Bunda Allah,
doakanlah kami yang berdosa ini,
sekarang dan waktu kami mati.
Amen.

name: Kemuliaan
content:
Kemuliaan kepada Bapa,
dan Putera,
dan Roh Kudus.
Seperti pada permulaan,
sekarang, selalu,
dan sepanjang segala abad.
Amen.

name: Kinh Lạy Cha
content:
Lạy Cha chúng con ở trên trời,
chúng con nguyện danh Cha cả sáng,
nước Cha trị đến,
ý Cha thể hiện dưới đất
cũng như trên trời.
Xin Cha cho chúng con
hôm nay lương thực hằng ngày,
và tha nợ chúng con
như chúng con cũng tha
kẻ có nợ chúng con.
Xin chớ để chúng con sa chước cám dỗ,
nhưng cứu chúng con cho khỏi sự dữ.
Amen.

name: Kinh Kính Mừng
content:
Kính mừng Maria đầy ơn phúc,
Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng Bà,
Bà có phúc lạ hơn mọi người nữ,
và Giêsu con lòng Bà
gồm phúc lạ.
Thánh Maria Đức Mẹ Chúa Trời,
cầu cho chúng con là kẻ có tội,
khi nay và trong giờ lâm tử.
Amen.

name: Kinh Sáng Danh
content:
Sáng danh Đức Chúa Cha,
và Đức Chúa Con,
và Đức Chúa Thánh Thần.
Bây giờ và hằng có,
và đời đời chẳng cùng.
Amen.

name: Baba Yetu
content:
Baba yetu uliye mbinguni,
Jina lako litakaswe.
Ufalme wako uje.
Matakwa yako yatimizwe
Duniani kama mbinguni.
Utupe leo mkate wetu
wa kila siku.
Utusamehe makosa yetu,
kama sisi tunavyowasamehe
wale wanaotukosea.
Usitutie majaribuni,
bali utuokoe na yule mwovu.
Ameni.

name: Salamu Maria
content:
Salamu Maria, umejawa neema,
Bwana yuko nawe.
Umebarikiwa miongoni mwa wanawake
na amebarikiwa
matunda ya tumbo lako, Yesu.
Mariam Mtakatifu, Mama wa Mungu,
tuombee sisi wenye dhambi
sasa na wakati wa kifo chetu.
Ameni.

name: አባታችን
content:
በሰማያት የምትኖር አባታችን ሆይ፣
ስምህ ይቀደስ፤
መንግሥትህ ትምጣ፤
ፈቃድህ በሰማይ እንደሆነ
በምድርም ይሁን፤
ዕለታዊ እንጀራችንን ዛሬ ስጠን፤
እኛ ደግሞ የበደሉንን
ይቅር እንደምንል፣
በደላችንን ይቅር በለን፤
ወደ ፈተና አትምራን፣
ከክፉ ግን አድነን።
አሜን።

name: ሰላም ለኪ ማርያም
content:
ሰላም ለኪ ማርያም፣
ጸጋ የሞላሽ፣
ጌታ ከአንቺ ጋር ነው።
ከሴቶች ሁሉ ትብረከሪ፣
ከፍሬ ማኅፀንሽ
ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ይብረክ።
ቅዱስ ማርያም፣ የእግዚአብሔር እናት፣
ለኛ ኃጢአተኞች ለምኝልን
አሁንና ስንሞት ጊዜ።
አሜን።

name: Miatyánk
content:
Mi Atyánk, aki a mennyekben vagy,
szenteltessék meg a te neved.
Jöjjön el a te országod.
Legyen meg a te akaratod,
miképpen mennyben,
úgy a földön is.
Mindennapi kenyerünket add meg nekünk ma.
És bocsásd meg a mi vétkeinket,
miképpen mi is megbocsátunk
az ellenünk vétkezőknek.
És ne vigy minket a kísértésbe,
de szabadíts meg a gonosztól.
Ámen.

name: Üdvözlégy Mária
content:
Üdvözlégy Mária, kegyelemmel teljes,
az Úr van teveled.
Áldott vagy te az asszonyok között,
és áldott a te méhednek gyümölcse, Jézus.
Asszonyunk Szűz Mária, Istennek szent Anyja,
imádkozzál érettünk, bűnösökért,
most és halálunk óráján.
Ámen.

name: Otče náš
content:
Otče náš, jenž jsi na nebesích,
posvěť se jméno tvé.
Přijď království tvé.
Buď vůle tvá
jako v nebi, tak i na zemi.
Chléb náš vezdejší dej nám dnes.
A odpusť nám naše viny,
jako i my odpouštíme
naším viníkům.
A neuveď nás v pokušení,
ale zbav nás od zlého.
Amen.

name: Zdrávas Maria
content:
Zdrávas, Maria, milostiplná,
Pán s tebou,
jsi požehnaná mezi ženami
a požehnaný plod života tvého, Ježíš.
Svatá Maria, Matko Boží,
pros za nás hříšné
nyní i v hodinu smrti naší.
Amen.

name: Otče náš
content:
Otče náš, ktorý si na nebesiach,
posväť sa meno tvoje,
prij nám kráľovstvo tvoje,
buď vôľa tvoja ako v nebi,
tak i na zemi.
Chlieb náš každodenný daj nám dnes
a odpusť nám naše viny,
ako i my odpúšťame
naším vinníkom.
A neuveď nás do pokušenia,
ale zbav nás Zlého.
Amen.

name: Zdravas' Mária
content:
Zdravas', Mária, milosti plná,
Pán s tebou.
Requiescat in pace benedictá si medzi ženami
a požehnaný je plod života tvojho, Ježiš.
Svätá Mária, Matka Božia,
pros za nás hriešnych
teraz i v hodinu smrti našej.
Amen.

name: Oče naš
content:
Oče naš, koji jesi na nebesima,
sveti se ime tvoje.
Dođi kraljevstvo tvoje.
Budi volja tvoja
kako na nebu tako i na zemlji.
Kruh naš svagdašnji daj nam danas.
I otpusti nam duge naše
kako i mi otpuštamo
dužnicima našim.
I ne uvedi nas u napast,
ego izbavi nas od zla.
Amen.

name: Zdravo Marijo
content:
Zdravo Marijo, milosti puna,
Gospodin s tobom.
Blagovana si ti između žena
i blagovan je plod utrobe tvoje, Isus.
Sveta Marijo, Majko Božja,
moli za nas grješnike
sada i u čas smrti naše.
Amen.

name: أبانا الذي في السماوات
content:
أبانا الذي في السماوات،
ليتقدس اسمك،
ليأتِ ملكوتك،
لتكن مشيئتك
كما في السماء كذلك على الأرض.
خبزنا كفافنا أعطنا اليوم،
واغفر لنا ذنوبنا
كما نغفر نحن أيضاً
للمذنبين إلينا،
ولا تُدخلنا في تجربة
لكن نجِّنا من الشرير.
آمين.

name: السلام عليكِ يا مريم
content:
السلام عليكِ يا مريم،
يا ممتلئةً نعمةً،
الربُّ معكِ.
مباركةٌ أنتِ في النساء،
ومباركٌ ثمرةُ بطنكِ يسوع.
يا قديسة مريم،
يا والدةَ الإله،
صلِّي لأجلنا نحن الخطأة،
الآن وفي ساعة وفاتنا.
آمين.

name: المجد للآب
content:
المجد للآب
والابن
والروح القدس.
كما كان في البدء
الآن وكل أوان
وإلى دهر الداهرين.
آمين.

name: صلاة الصباح
content:
يا ربي وإلهي،
أشكرك على هذا النهار الجديد.
أقدِّم لك أفكاري وأعمالي وصلواتي.
كن معي في كل خطوة أخطوها،
وأنِر دربي بنورك الإلهي.
آمين.

name: صلاة المساء
content:
يا رب يسوع المسيح،
أشكرك على نعم هذا اليوم.
aغفر لي كل خطيئة ارتكبتها.
احرسني الليلة في سلامك،
وأعطني نوماً هادئاً
لأستيقظ غداً بقوة جديدة.
آمين.

name: صلاة القديس ميخائيل
content:
أيها القديس ميخائيل رئيس الملائكة،
دافع عنا في المعركة.
كن لنا مِحراباً ضد شرور الشيطان.
نحن نتضرع إليك:
أدحر إلى الجحيم الشيطان
وكل الأرواح الشريرة
التي تجول في العالم
باحثةً عن إهلاك النفوس.
آمين.

name: Հայր մեր
content:
Հայր մեր, որ երկնքումս ես,
սուրբ եղիցի անունդ,
եկեսցէ արքայութիւնդ,
եղիցի կամք քո,
ոrpէс յերկինս, եւ յերկրի։
Զhաց մեր հանապazean
տուր մեզ այuór,
eւ թող մեզ zborc մեր,
or, eւ մeirs թողumir
zborc n'ere bots.
EUW mi' anc'esc's zmez i chart',
ayl patrasya zmez i kakan.
Amin.

name: Ողջ՜ ե՛ղ, Մարիամ
content:
Ողջ՜ ե՛ղ, Մարիամ,
շնորհագե՛ղ,
Տէրն ընդ քեզ,
orhnut'iwn k'o i kanants',
barreal iwvk'anc' pluts'k'n i k'oc'.
S·B· Mariam, Astvacacanch',
bakhshir mardinots' anots',
aysor yev yard k'un merelu.
Amin.

name: Փառք Հայրն
content:
Փառք Հօրն
f Uarrn,
f Srhbn Hocwn,
or, orn en skszbanen,
aysor f miamsayn,
f haviteans hawiteanats'.
Amin.

name: Առաւօտեան աղօթք
content:
Տէ՛ր Աստուա՛ծ,
гodаракем Кɛɛzi arї дɛɛdɛ.
Огнɛцɛ іхаɛ цхозхаɛ дɛɛ
Ohnacea ikhsae tshozkhae dae
Помогни мне жить
по Твоей воле.
Аминь.

name: მამაო ჩვენო
content:
მამაო ჩვენო, რომელი ხარ ცათა შინა,
წმიდა იყავნ სახელი შენი,
მოვედინ სუფევა შენი,
იყავნ ნება შენი,
ვითარცა ცათა შინა,
ეგრეცა ქვეყანასა ზედა.
პური ჩვენი არსობისა
მომეც ჩვენ დღეს,
და მომიტევენ ჩვენ თანანადებნი ჩვენნი,
ვითარცა ჩვენ მიტევებთ
თანამდებთა მათ ჩვენთა,
და ნუ შემიყვანებ ჩვენ განსაცდელსა,
არამედ მიხსენ ჩვენ ბოროტისაგან.
ამინ.

name: გიხაროდეს, მარიამ
content:
გიხაროდეს, მარიამ,
მადლითა სავსე,
უფალი შენ თანა,
კურთხეულ ხარ შენ დედათა შორის,
და კურთხეულ არს
ნაყოფი მუცლისა შენისა, იესო.
წმიდაო მარიამ, ღვთის დედაო,
ოხედ ჩვენ ცოდვილთათვის
აწ და მარადის
და სოფლის უკუნისამდე.
ამინ.

name: დიდება
content:
დიდება მამასა
და ძესა
და სულსა წმიდასა,
ვითარცა იყო დასაბამითგან,
არს აწ და მარადის
და უკუნითი უკუნისამდე.
ამინ.

name: பரலோகத்தில் இருக்கிற
content:
பரலோகத்தில் இருக்கிற எங்கள் பிதாவே,
உம்முடைய நாமம் பரிசுத்தப்படுவதாக.
உம்முடைய ராஜ்யம் வருவதாக.
உம்முடைய சித்தம் பரலோகத்திலே
செய்யப்படுவதுபோல் பூமியிலேயும் செய்யப்படுவதாக.
இன்று எங்களுக்கு வேண்டிய ஆகாரத்தை எங்களுக்குத் தாரும்.
நாங்கள் எங்களுக்குக் கடன்பட்டவர்களை
மன்னிப்பதுபோல் எங்கள் கடன்களை மன்னியும்.
ஆமென்.

name: அருள் நிறைந்த மரியே
மாலை வேண்டுதல்
content:
ஆண்டவரே, இயேசு கிறிஸ்துவே,
இன்று நாள் முழுவதும்
தந்த அன்புக்கு நன்றி.
தவறி நடந்த நேரங்களை மன்னியும்.
ஆழ்ந்த உறக்கம் தாரும்,
மறுநாள் புதுப்பலத்துடன் எழுவேன்.
ஆமென்.

name: ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവേ
content:
സ്വർഗ്ഗസ്ഥനായ ഞങ്ങളുടെ പിതാവേ,
അവിടുത്തെ നാമം പരിശുദ്ധമാകട്ടെ.
അവിടുത്തെ രാജ്യം വരട്ടെ.
അവിടുത്തെ തിരുമനസ്സ്
സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെന്നപോലെ
ഭൂമിയിലും ആകട്ടെ.
ഞങ്ങൾക്ക് ആവശ്യമായ ആഹാരം ഇന്ന് തരണമേ.
ഞങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങളോട് അപരാധം ചെയ്തവരോട്
ക്ഷമിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ
ഞങ്ങളുടെ അപരാധങ്ങൾ ക്ഷമിക്കണമേ.
ആമേൻ.

name: സ്വസ്തി മറിയമേ
പ്രഭാത പ്രാർഥന
content:
കർത്താവേ, ഈ പ്രഭാതത്തിൽ
ഞാൻ എന്നെത്തന്നെ
അങ്ങേക്ക് സമർപ്പിക്കുന്നു.
ഈ ദിനം മുഴുവൻ
അങ്ങയുടെ ഇഷ്ടമനുസരിച്ച്
ജീവിക്കാൻ കൃപ നൽകണമേ.
ആമേൻ.

name: పరలోకమందున్న మా తండ్రీ
నమస్కారం మరియమ్మా
content:
నమస్కారం మరియమ్మా, కృపతో నిండినదానా,
ప్రభువు నీతో ఉన్నాడు.
స్త్రీలలో నీవు ధన్యురాలవు,
నీ గర్భఫలమైన యేసు ధన్యుడు.
పరిశుద్ధ మరియమ్మా, దేవుని తల్లీ,
మాకోసం వేడుకో,
ఇప్పుడు మరియు మన మరణ సమయంలో.
ఆమేన్.

name: ప్రభాత ప్రార్థన
content:
ప్రభువైన యేసు క్రీస్తూ,
ఈ పొద్దు నీకు కృతజ్ఞతలు.
నా పాపాలు క్షమించుము,
నన్ను నీ మార్గంలో నడిపించుము.
ఆమేన్.

name: Baba Wa Tí Ó Wà Lórún
content:
Baba wa tí ó wà lórún,
kí orúkọ rẹ jẹ mímọ́,
kí ìjọba rẹ dé,
kí ìfẹ́ rẹ ṣẹ
ní orí ilẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti ṣẹ lórún.
Fún wa lónì oúnjẹ wa ojoojúmọ́.
Dárí jí wa lẹ́bi wa,
gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ti ń dárí jí
awọn tí ó ṣẹ sí wa.
Máa fi wa sínú àdánwò,
ṣùgbọ́n gba wa lọ́wọ́ búburú.
Àmín.

name: Ekí rẹ, Màríà
content:
Ekí rẹ, Màríà, tí ó kún fún oore-ọ̀fẹ́,
Ìjọba Ọlọ́run wà pẹ̀lú rẹ.
O jẹ olùbùkún jù lọ lára àwọn obìnrin,
èso inú rẹ Jésù sì jẹ olùbùkún.
Òmìnira Màríà, Ìyá Ọlọ́run,
bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún wa àwọn ẹlẹ́ṣẹ̀,
í báyìí àti ní àkókò ikú wa.
Àmín.

name: Ìjọbá Àárọ̀
content:
Olúwa mi Jésù Krístì,
mò dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ rẹ fún ọjọ́ tuntun yìí.
rí mi bí mo ṣe ń gbé ìgbésí ayé mi
ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ rẹ.
Àmín.

name: Nna Anyị Nọ N'Eluigwe
content:
Nna anyị nọ n'eluigwe,
ka aha gị dị nsọ,
ka alaeze gị bịa,
ka ọchịchọ gị ruo ụzọ
n'ala dị ka ọ dị na eluigwe.
Nye anyị taa nri anyị nke ụbọchị a.
Gbaghaa anyị mmejọ anyị,
dị ka anyị na-agbaghaa ndị
na-emejọ anyị.
Āzụchaghị anyị na nnwaị,
kana zọpụta anyị n'ọjọọ.
Emen.

name: Nnọọ Meri
content:
Nnọọ Meri, jupụtara n'ọla,
Onye Nwe anyị nọ n'ime gị.
I dị ngọzi n'etiti ụmụ nwanyị,
ọ dị ngọzi n'ime afọ gị bụ Jisos.
Nne Chukwu Meri Dị Nsọ,
rịọ arịọ maka anyị ndị njo,
ugbu a na n'oge ọnwụ anyị.
Emen.

name: Ekpere Ụtụtụ
content:
Nna Chineke,
daalụ maka ụbọchị ọhụrụ a.
Nye m ike ịhụ n'anya gị
nọọ na ọrụ gị taa.
Emen.

name: Prayer of Saint Francis (Peace Prayer)
Angel of God (Guardian Angel Prayer)
content:
Angel of God, my guardian dear,
to whom God's love commits me here,
ever this day be at my side,
to light and guard, to rule and guide.
Amen.

name: Grace Before Meals
content:
Bless us, O Lord, and these Thy gifts,
which we are about to receive from Thy bounty,
through Christ our Lord.
Amen.

name: Prayer to the Holy Spirit
content:
Come, Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of Thy faithful,
and kindle in them the fire of Thy love.
Send forth Thy Spirit, and they shall be created,
and Thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

Let us pray.
O God, who by the light of the Holy Spirit
didst instruct the hearts of the faithful,
grant that by the same Holy Spirit
we may be truly wise
and ever enjoy His consolations.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.

name: Prayer Before a Crucifix
content:
Look down upon me, good and gentle Jesus,
while before Thy face I humbly kneel,
and with burning soul pray and beseech Thee
to fix deep in my heart lively sentiments of faith, hope, and charity,
true contrition for my sins,
and a firm purpose of amendment,
while I contemplate, with great love and tender pity,
Thy five most precious wounds,
pondering over them within me,
and calling to mind the words which David, Thy prophet,
said of Thee, my Jesus:
'They have pierced My hands and My feet,
they have numbered all My bones.'
Amen.

name: Prayer to Saint Joseph
content:
To you, O blessed Joseph, do we come in our tribulation,
and having implored the help of your most holy Spouse,
we confidently invoke your patronage also.
Through that charity which bound you to the Immaculate Virgin Mother of God
and through the paternal love with which you embraced the Child Jesus,
we humbly beg you to look graciously upon the inheritance
which Jesus Christ has purchased by His Blood,
and with your power and strength to aid us in our necessities.
O most watchful Guardian of the Holy Family,
defend the chosen children of Jesus Christ;
O most loving father, ward off from us every contagion of error and corrupting influence;
O our most mighty protector, be propitious to us
and from heaven assist us in our struggle with the power of darkness;
and, as once you rescued the Child Jesus from mortal danger,
so now defend God's Holy Church from the snares of the enemy and from all adversity;
shield, too, each one of us by your constant protection,
so that, supported by your example and your assistance,
we may be able to live piously, to die holily,
and to obtain eternal happiness in heaven.
Amen.

name: Eternal Rest (Prayer for the Dead)
content:
Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord,
and let perpetual light shine upon them.
May they rest in peace.
Amen.
May their souls and the souls of all the faithful departed,
through the mercy of God, rest in peace.
Amen.

name: Suscipe (Prayer of Saint Ignatius)
content:
Take, Lord, and receive
all my liberty, my memory, my understanding,
and my entire will,
all that I have and possess.
You have given all to me.
To you, O Lord, I return it.
All is yours; do with it what you will.
Give me only your love and your grace;
that is enough for me.
Amen.

name: Act of Faith
content:
O my God, I firmly believe
that You are one God in three divine Persons,
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
I believe that Your divine Son became man
and died for our sins,
and that He will come to judge
the living and the dead.
I believe these and all the truths
which the Holy Catholic Church teaches,
because You have revealed them,
who can neither deceive nor be deceived.

name: Act of Hope
content:
O my God, relying on Your infinite goodness and promises,
I hope to obtain pardon of my sins,
the help of Your grace,
and life everlasting,
through the merits of Jesus Christ,
my Lord and Redeemer.

name: Act of Love
content:
O my God, I love You above all things,
with my whole heart and soul,
because You are all good and worthy of all my love.
I love my neighbor as myself for the love of You.
I forgive all who have injured me,
and ask pardon of all whom I have injured.

name: The Divine Praises
content:
Blessed be God.
Blessed be His Holy Name.
Blessed be Jesus Christ, true God and true Man.
Blessed be the Name of Jesus.
Blessed be His Most Sacred Heart.
Blessed be His Most Precious Blood.
Blessed be Jesus in the Most Holy Sacrament of the Altar.
Blessed be the Holy Spirit, the Paraclete.
Blessed be the great Mother of God, Mary most Holy.
Blessed be her Holy and Immaculate Conception.
Blessed be her Glorious Assumption.
Blessed be the name of Mary, Virgin and Mother.
Blessed be Saint Joseph, her most chaste spouse.
Blessed be God in His Angels and in His Saints.

name: Let Nothing Disturb You (Prayer of Saint Teresa of Ávila)
content:
Let nothing disturb you,
let nothing frighten you,
all things are passing away:
God never changes.
Patience obtains all things.
Whoever has God lacks nothing;
God alone suffices.

name: Prayer Before Study (Prayer of Saint Thomas Aquinas)
content:
Creator of all things, true source of light and wisdom, origin of all being,
graciously let a ray of Your light penetrate
the darkness of my understanding.
Take from me the double darkness
in which I have been born,
an obscurity of sin and ignorance.
Give me a sharp sense of understanding,
a retentive memory,
and the ability to grasp things correctly and fundamentally.
Grant me the talent of being exact in my explanations,
and the ability to express myself with thoroughness and charm.
Point out the beginning,
direct the progress,
and help in the completion.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.

name: Grace After Meals
content:
We give Thee thanks for all Thy benefits,
O Almighty God,
who livest and reignest,
world without end.
Amen.
May the souls of the faithful departed,
through the mercy of God,
rest in peace.
Amen.

name: De Profundis (Psalm 130)
content:
Out of the depths I have cried to Thee, O Lord;
Lord, hear my voice.
Let Thine ears be attentive
to the voice of my supplication.
If Thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities,
Lord, who shall stand it?
For with Thee there is merciful forgiveness,
and by reason of Thy law, I have waited for Thee, O Lord.
My soul hath relied on His word;
my soul hath hoped in the Lord.
From the morning watch even until night,
let Israel hope in the Lord.
Because with the Lord there is mercy,
and with Him plentiful redemption.
And He shall redeem Israel
from all his iniquities.
Amen.

name: O Sacrament Most Holy
content:
O Sacrament most holy,
O Sacrament divine,
all praise and all thanksgiving
be every moment Thine.

name: Jesus Prayer
content:
Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God,
have mercy on me, a sinner.

name: Nicene Creed
content:
I believe in one God,
the Father almighty,
maker of heaven and earth,
of all things visible and invisible.
I believe in one Lord Jesus Christ,
the Only Begotten Son of God,
born of the Father before all ages.
God from God, Light from Light,
true God from true God,
begotten, not made, consubstantial with the Father;
through him all things were made.
For us men and for our salvation
he came down from heaven,
and by the Holy Spirit was incarnate of the Virgin Mary,
and became man.
For our sake he was crucified under Pontius Pilate,
he suffered death and was buried,
and rose again on the third day
in accordance with the Scriptures.
He ascended into heaven
and is seated at the right hand of the Father.
He will come again in glory
to judge the living and the dead
and his kingdom will have no end.
I believe in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the giver of life,
who proceeds from the Father and the Son,
who with the Father and the Son is adored and glorified,
who has spoken through the prophets.
I believe in one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church.
I confess one Baptism for the forgiveness of sins
and I look forward to the resurrection of the dead
and the life of the world to come.
Amen.

name: Litany of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Litany of Loreto)
content:
Lord, have mercy on us.
Christ, have mercy on us.
Lord, have mercy on us.
Christ, hear us. Christ, graciously hear us.
God the Father of Heaven, have mercy on us.
God the Son, Redeemer of the world, have mercy on us.
God the Holy Spirit, have mercy on us.

Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, spare us, O Lord.
Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, graciously hear us, O Lord.
Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, have mercy on us.
V. Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
Let us pray.
Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord God, unto us Thy servants,
that we may rejoice in continual health of mind and body;
and by the glorious intercession of Blessed Mary, ever Virgin,
be delivered from present sorrow,
and enter into the joy of eternal happiness.
Through Christ our Lord.

name: Sub Tuum Praesidium
content:
We fly to thy patronage,
O holy Mother of God;
despise not our petitions in our necessities,
but deliver us always from all dangers,
O glorious and blessed Virgin.
Amen.

name: Te Deum
content:
We praise Thee, O God, we acknowledge Thee to be the Lord.
All the earth doth worship Thee, the Father everlasting.
To Thee all Angels cry aloud, the Heavens and all the Powers therein.
To Thee Cherubim and Seraphim continually do cry:
Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of Sabaoth;
Heaven and earth are full of the Majesty of Thy glory.
The glorious company of the Apostles praise Thee.
The goodly fellowship of the Prophets praise Thee.
The noble army of Martyrs praise Thee.
The holy Church throughout all the world doth acknowledge Thee,
the Father of an infinite Majesty,
Thine adorable, true, and only Son,
also the Holy Ghost, the Comforter.
Thou art the King of Glory, O Christ.
Thou art the everlasting Son of the Father.
When Thou tookest upon Thee to deliver man,
Thou didst not abhor the Virgin's womb.
When Thou hadst overcome the sharpness of death,
Thou didst open the Kingdom of Heaven to all believers.
Thou sittest at the right hand of God, in the glory of the Father.
We believe that Thou shalt come to be our Judge.
We therefore pray Thee, help Thy servants,
whom Thou hast redeemed with Thy precious Blood.
Make them to be numbered with Thy Saints, in glory everlasting.
O Lord, save Thy people, and bless Thine heritage.
Govern them, and lift them up for ever.
Day by day we magnify Thee,
and we worship Thy Name ever, world without end.
Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us this day without sin.
O Lord, have mercy upon us, have mercy upon us.
O Lord, let Thy mercy lighten upon us, as our trust is in Thee.
O Lord, in Thee have I trusted, let me never be confounded.
Amen.

name: Gloria in Excelsis Deo
content:
Glory to God in the highest,
and on earth peace to people of good will.
We praise you,
we bless you,
we adore you,
we glorify you,
we give you thanks for your great glory,
Lord God, heavenly King,
O God, almighty Father.
Lord Jesus Christ, Only Begotten Son,
Lord God, Lamb of God, Son of the Father,
you take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us;
you take away the sins of the world, receive our prayer;
you are seated at the right hand of the Father, have mercy on us.
For you alone are the Holy One,
you alone are the Lord,
you alone are the Most High,
Jesus Christ,
with the Holy Spirit,
in the glory of God the Father.
Amen.

name: Sanctus
content:
Holy, Holy, Holy Lord God of hosts.
Heaven and earth are full of your glory.
Hosanna in the highest.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
Hosanna in the highest.

name: Agnus Dei
content:
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us.
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us.
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
grant us peace.

name: Miraculous Medal Prayer
content:
O Mary, conceived without sin,
pray for us who have recourse to thee.
(Repeat three times.)

name: O Salutaris Hostia
content:
O saving Victim, opening wide
The gate of Heaven to man below;
Our foes press hard on every side;
Thine aid supply; thy strength bestow.

To thy great name be endless praise,
Immortal Godhead, One in Three.
Oh, grant us endless length of days,
In our true native land with thee.

name: Tantum Ergo
content:
Down in adoration falling,
Lo! the Sacred Host we hail,
Lo! o'er ancient forms departing
Newer rites of grace prevail;
Faith for all defects supplying,
Where the feeble senses fail.

To the Everlasting Father,
And the Son Who reigns on high,
With the Holy Ghost proceeding
Forth from Each eternally,
Be salvation, honour, blessing,
Might, and endless majesty.

name: Litany of Humility
content:
O Jesus, meek and humble of heart,
Hear me.

From the desire of being esteemed,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being loved,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being extolled,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being honored,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being praised,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being preferred to others,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being consulted,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the desire of being approved,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being humiliated,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being despised,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of suffering rebukes,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being calumniated,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being forgotten,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being ridiculed,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being wronged,
Deliver me, Jesus.
From the fear of being suspected,
Deliver me, Jesus.

That others may be loved more than I,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
That others may be esteemed more than I,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
That, in the opinion of the world, others may increase and I may decrease,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
That others may be chosen and I set aside,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
That others may be praised and I unnoticed,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
That others may be preferred to me in everything,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
That others may become holier than I, provided that I may become as holy as I should,
Jesus, grant me the grace to desire it.
Amen.

name: Act of Spiritual Communion
content:
My Jesus, I believe that You are present in the Most Holy Sacrament.
I love You above all things,
and I desire to receive You into my soul.
Since I cannot at this moment receive You sacramentally,
come at least spiritually into my heart.
I embrace You as if You were already there,
and unite myself wholly to You.
Never permit me to be separated from You.
Amen.

name: Ave Maris Stella
content:
Hail, O Star of the ocean,
God's own Mother blest,
Ever sinless Virgin,
Gate of heavenly rest.

Taking that sweet Ave
Which from Gabriel came,
Peace confirm within us,
Changing Eva's name.

Break the captives' fetters,
Light on blindness pour,
All our ills expelling,
Every bliss implore.

Show thyself a Mother,
Offer Him our sighs,
Who for us Incarnate
Did not thee despise.

Virgin of all virgins,
To thy shelter take us,
Gentlest of the gentle,
Chaste and gentle make us.

Still, as on we journey,
Help our weak endeavor,
Till with thee and Jesus
We rejoice for ever.

Through the highest heaven,
To the almighty Three,
Father, Son, and Spirit,
One same glory be.
Amen.

name: Confiteor (I Confess)
content:
I confess to almighty God
and to you, my brothers and sisters,
that I have greatly sinned
in my thoughts and in my words,
in what I have done and in what I have failed to do.
Through my fault, through my fault,
through my most grievous fault;
therefore I ask blessed Mary ever-Virgin,
all the Angels and Saints,
and you, my brothers and sisters,
to pray for me to the Lord our God.

name: Prayer of Saint Patrick (Christ Be With Me)
content:
Christ with me, Christ before me, Christ behind me,
Christ in me, Christ beneath me, Christ above me,
Christ on my right, Christ on my left,
Christ when I lie down, Christ when I sit down, Christ when I arise,
Christ in the heart of every man who thinks of me,
Christ in the mouth of everyone who speaks of me,
Christ in every eye that sees me,
Christ in every ear that hears me.

name: Novena to the Sacred Heart of Jesus
content:
O Most Holy Heart of Jesus, fountain of every blessing, I adore You, I love You, and with lively sorrow for my sins I offer You this poor heart of mine.
Make me humble, patient, pure, and wholly obedient to Your will.
Grant, good Jesus, that I may live in You and for You.
Protect me in the midst of danger; comfort me in my afflictions;
give me health of body, assistance in my temporal needs,
Your blessing on all that I do, and the grace of a holy death.

Sacred Heart of Jesus, I place all my trust in You.

(Repeat this novena prayer once each day for nine consecutive days, asking for a particular favor, and conclude with an Our Father, Hail Mary, and Glory Be.)
Amen.

name: Lectio Divina — Praying with Scripture
content:
Lectio Divina, 'divine reading,' is an ancient way of praying with Sacred Scripture in four simple steps. Choose a short Gospel passage and move slowly through each movement.

1. LECTIO — Read
Read the passage slowly, aloud if you can. Let the words settle without rushing to the next line.

2. MEDITATIO — Meditate
Read the passage again. Notice the word or phrase that stays with you. Sit with it. What is God saying to you through it?

3. ORATIO — Pray
Respond to God in your own words — gratitude, sorrow, a question, a desire — as it rises in your heart.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Contemplate
Set words aside and simply rest in God's presence.

'Be still, and know that I am God.' — Psalm 46:10

name: Examination of Conscience
content:
Before Confession, or as a quiet prayer at the end of the day, examine your conscience in the presence of God's love and mercy.

• Have I put God first today — in my thoughts, my words, my time?
• Have I prayed, or let the day crowd prayer out?
• Have I honored my parents, family, and those placed over me?
• Have I hurt anyone through anger, unkind words, or neglect?
• Have I been honest, or have I lied, gossiped, or judged another unfairly?
• Have I been faithful and pure in my relationships and my thoughts?
• Have I taken what is not mine, or been ungrateful for what I have?
• Have I envied others, or trusted in what God has given me?

Lord, for what I have done, and for what I have failed to do, I am sorry. Help me to love You and my neighbor more faithfully tomorrow.

(Continue with the Act of Contrition.)

name: İsa'nın Kutsal Kalbine Dokuz Günlük Dua (Novena)
content:
Ey İsa'nın en kutsal Kalbi, her bereketin pınarı, Seni tapıyor ve seviyorum; günahlarım için içten pişmanlıkla bu yoksul kalbimi Sana sunuyorum.
Beni alçakgönüllü, sabırlı, temiz ve tamamen Senin isteğine bağlı kıl.
İyi İsa'm, Senin içinde ve Senin için yaşamamı bağışla.
Tehlike anında beni koru; sıkıntılarımda beni teselli et;
bedenimin sağlığını, günlük ihtiyaçlarımda yardımını,
yaptığım her şeyde bereketini ve kutsal bir ölüm lütfunu ver.

İsa'nın Kutsal Kalbi, tüm güvenimi Sana bırakıyorum.

(Bu duayı, özel bir dilekle, dokuz gün üst üste her gün bir kez tekrarlayın ve bir Rabbin Duası, bir Selam Sana Meryem ve bir Şan Olsun ile bitirin.)
Amin.

content:

name: Lectio Divina — Kutsal Kitapla Dua Etmek
content:
Lectio Divina, yani 'kutsal okuma', Kutsal Kitap ile dua etmenin dört adımdan oluşan çok eski bir yoludur. Kısa bir İncil bölümü seçin ve her adımda yavaşça ilerleyin.

1. LECTIO — Oku
Metni yavaşça, mümkünse sesli okuyun. Kelimelerin içinize sinmesine izin verin, acele etmeyin.

2. MEDITATIO — Düşün
Metni yeniden okuyun. Sizde kalan kelime ya da cümleye dikkat edin. Onunla kalın. Tanrı size bu sözle ne söylüyor?

3. ORATIO — Dua Et
İçinizde doğan minnet, pişmanlık, soru ya da özlemle Tanrı'ya kendi sözlerinizle cevap verin.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Sessizce Kal
Sözleri bir kenara bırakıp yalnızca Tanrı'nın huzurunda dinlenin.

'Sakin olun ve bilin ki, ben Tanrı'yım.' — Mezmur 46:10

name: Vicdan Muhasebesi
content:
Günah çıkarmadan önce ya da günün sonunda sessiz bir dua olarak, Tanrı'nın sevgisi ve merhameti huzurunda vicdanınızı yoklayın.

• Bugün Tanrı'yı ilk sıraya koydum mu — düşüncelerimde, sözlerimde, zamanımda?
• Dua ettim mi, yoksa gün duayı bastırmasına izin mi verdim?
• Ana babama, aileme ve üzerimde otorite sahibi olanlara saygı gösterdim mi?
• Öfke, kaba sözler ya da ilgisizlikle birini incittim mi?
• Dürüst müydüm, yoksa yalan mı söyledim, dedikodu mu yaptım, birini haksızca mı yargıladım?
• İlişkilerimde ve düşüncelerimde sadık ve temiz kaldım mı?
• Bana ait olmayanı aldım mı, ya da sahip olduklarıma nankörlük ettim mi?
• Başkalarını kıskandım mı, yoksa Tanrı'nın bana verdiklerine güvendim mi?

Ey Rabbim, yaptıklarım ve yapmadıklarım için üzgünüm. Yarın Seni ve komşumu daha sadakatle sevmeme yardım et.

(Pişmanlık Duası ile devam edin.)

name: Novene zum Heiligsten Herzen Jesu
content:
O Heiligstes Herz Jesu, Quelle jeden Segens, ich bete Dich an, ich liebe Dich, und mit aufrichtiger Reue über meine Sünden opfere ich Dir dieses arme Herz.
Mache mich demütig, geduldig, rein und ganz Deinem Willen gehorsam.
Gewähre, guter Jesus, dass ich in Dir und für Dich lebe.
Beschütze mich in Gefahr; tröste mich in meinen Nöten;
schenke mir Gesundheit an Leib, Beistand in meinen irdischen Anliegen,
Deinen Segen auf all mein Tun und die Gnade eines seligen Todes.

Herz Jesu, ich vertraue auf Dich.

(Wiederholen Sie dieses Novenengebet neun Tage lang einmal täglich für ein besonderes Anliegen und schließen Sie jeweils mit einem Vaterunser, einem Gegrüßet seist du Maria und einem Ehre sei dem Vater ab.)
Amen.

content:

Durch Christus, unseren Herrn. Amen.

name: Lectio Divina — Beten mit der Heiligen Schrift
content:
Lectio Divina, das „geistliche Lesen", ist eine uralte Weise, mit der Heiligen Schrift in vier einfachen Schritten zu beten. Wählen Sie einen kurzen Abschnitt aus dem Evangelium und gehen Sie langsam durch jeden Schritt.

1. LECTIO — Lesen
Lesen Sie den Text langsam, wenn möglich laut. Lassen Sie die Worte wirken, ohne zur nächsten Zeile zu eilen.

2. MEDITATIO — Betrachten
Lesen Sie den Text erneut. Achten Sie auf das Wort oder den Satz, der bei Ihnen bleibt. Verweilen Sie dabei. Was sagt Gott Ihnen dadurch?

3. ORATIO — Beten
Antworten Sie Gott mit Ihren eigenen Worten — Dank, Reue, eine Frage, eine Sehnsucht — so wie es in Ihrem Herzen aufsteigt.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Verweilen
Legen Sie die Worte beiseite und ruhen Sie einfach in der Gegenwart Gottes.

„Seid still und erkennet, dass ich Gott bin." — Psalm 46,11

name: Gewissenserforschung
content:
Vor der Beichte, oder als stilles Gebet am Ende des Tages, prüfen Sie Ihr Gewissen in der Gegenwart der Liebe und Barmherzigkeit Gottes.

• Habe ich Gott heute an die erste Stelle gesetzt — in meinen Gedanken, meinen Worten, meiner Zeit?
• Habe ich gebetet, oder habe ich zugelassen, dass der Tag das Gebet verdrängt?
• Habe ich meine Eltern, meine Familie und die mir übergeordneten Menschen geachtet?
• Habe ich jemanden durch Zorn, unfreundliche Worte oder Vernachlässigung verletzt?
• War ich ehrlich, oder habe ich gelogen, geklatscht oder jemanden ungerecht beurteilt?
• War ich treu und rein in meinen Beziehungen und meinen Gedanken?
• Habe ich mir genommen, was mir nicht gehört, oder war ich undankbar für das, was ich habe?
• Habe ich andere beneidet, oder habe ich auf das vertraut, was Gott mir gegeben hat?

Herr, für das, was ich getan habe, und für das, was ich versäumt habe, bitte ich um Vergebung. Hilf mir, Dich und meinen Nächsten morgen treuer zu lieben.

(Fahren Sie fort mit dem Akt der Reue.)

name: Novena al Sagrado Corazón de Jesús
content:
Oh Sagrado Corazón de Jesús, fuente de toda bendición, os adoro, os amo, y con vivo dolor de mis pecados os ofrezco este pobre corazón mío.
Hacedme humilde, paciente, puro y enteramente obediente a vuestra voluntad.
Concededme, buen Jesús, que viva en Vos y para Vos.
Protegedme en medio del peligro; consoladme en mis aflicciones;
dadme salud de cuerpo, ayuda en mis necesidades temporales,
vuestra bendición en todo lo que hago, y la gracia de una muerte santa.

Sagrado Corazón de Jesús, en Vos confío.

(Repita esta oración de la novena una vez al día durante nueve días consecutivos, pidiendo un favor particular, y concluya con un Padre Nuestro, un Ave María y un Gloria.)
Amén.

name: Lectio Divina — Orar con la Escritura
content:
La Lectio Divina, «lectura divina», es una manera antigua de orar con la Sagrada Escritura en cuatro pasos sencillos. Elige un pasaje breve del Evangelio y avanza despacio por cada paso.

1. LECTIO — Leer
Lee el pasaje despacio, en voz alta si puedes. Deja que las palabras se asienten sin apresurarte a la siguiente línea.

2. MEDITATIO — Meditar
Lee el pasaje de nuevo. Fíjate en la palabra o frase que permanece contigo. Detente en ella. ¿Qué te dice Dios a través de ella?

3. ORATIO — Orar
Responde a Dios con tus propias palabras — gratitud, dolor, una pregunta, un deseo — según surja en tu corazón.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Contemplar
Deja las palabras a un lado y simplemente descansa en la presencia de Dios.

«Estad quietos y sabed que Yo soy Dios.» — Salmo 46, 11

name: Examen de Conciencia
content:
Antes de la Confesión, o como oración tranquila al final del día, examina tu conciencia en presencia del amor y la misericordia de Dios.

• ¿He puesto a Dios en primer lugar hoy — en mis pensamientos, mis palabras, mi tiempo?
• ¿He orado, o he dejado que el día desplazara la oración?
• ¿He honrado a mis padres, a mi familia y a quienes tienen autoridad sobre mí?
• ¿He herido a alguien con ira, palabras hirientes o indiferencia?
• ¿He sido sincero, o he mentido, murmurado o juzgado injustamente a otro?
• ¿He sido fiel y puro en mis relaciones y en mis pensamientos?
• ¿He tomado lo que no es mío, o he sido ingrato por lo que tengo?
• ¿He envidiado a otros, o he confiado en lo que Dios me ha dado?

Señor, por lo que he hecho y por lo que he dejado de hacer, te pido perdón. Ayúdame a amarte a Ti y a mi prójimo con más fidelidad mañana.

(Continúa con el Acto de Contrición.)

name: Neuvaine au Sacré-Cœur de Jésus
content:
Ô Cœur très saint de Jésus, source de toute bénédiction, je Vous adore, je Vous aime, et avec un vif regret de mes péchés, je Vous offre ce pauvre cœur qui est le mien.
Rendez-moi humble, patient, pur et entièrement soumis à Votre volonté.
Accordez, bon Jésus, que je vive en Vous et pour Vous.
Protégez-moi au milieu du danger ; consolez-moi dans mes afflictions ;
donnez-moi la santé du corps, l'assistance dans mes besoins temporels,
Votre bénédiction sur tout ce que je fais, et la grâce d'une sainte mort.

Cœur Sacré de Jésus, je mets en Vous toute ma confiance.

(Répétez cette prière de neuvaine une fois par jour pendant neuf jours consécutifs, en demandant une grâce particulière, et terminez par un Notre Père, un Je vous salue Marie et un Gloire au Père.)
Amen.

name: Lectio Divina — Prier avec l’Écriture
content:
La Lectio Divina, « lecture divine », est une manière ancienne de prier avec la Sainte Écriture en quatre étapes simples. Choisissez un court passage de l'Évangile et avancez lentement à travers chaque étape.

1. LECTIO — Lire
Lisez le passage lentement, à voix haute si possible. Laissez les mots s'installer sans vous précipiter vers la ligne suivante.

2. MEDITATIO — Méditer
Relisez le passage. Repérez le mot ou la phrase qui reste en vous. Demeurez-y. Que vous dit Dieu à travers lui ?

3. ORATIO — Prier
Répondez à Dieu avec vos propres mots — gratitude, regret, une question, un désir — selon ce qui monte dans votre cœur.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Contempler
Laissez les mots de côté et reposez-vous simplement dans la présence de Dieu.

« Arrêtez, et reconnaissez que je suis Dieu. » — Psaume 46, 11

name: Examen de Conscience
content:
Avant la Confession, ou comme prière silencieuse à la fin de la journée, examinez votre conscience en présence de l'amour et de la miséricorde de Dieu.

• Ai-je mis Dieu à la première place aujourd'hui — dans mes pensées, mes paroles, mon temps ?
• Ai-je prié, ou ai-je laissé la journée évincer la prière ?
• Ai-je honoré mes parents, ma famille et ceux qui ont autorité sur moi ?
• Ai-je blessé quelqu'un par colère, paroles dures ou négligence ?
• Ai-je été honnête, ou ai-je menti, médit ou jugé quelqu'un injustement ?
• Ai-je été fidèle et pur dans mes relations et dans mes pensées ?
• Ai-je pris ce qui ne m'appartenait pas, ou ai-je été ingrat pour ce que j'ai ?
• Ai-je envié les autres, ou ai-je fait confiance à ce que Dieu m'a donné ?

Seigneur, pour ce que j'ai fait, et pour ce que j'ai omis de faire, je suis désolé. Aide-moi à T'aimer, Toi et mon prochain, plus fidèlement demain.

(Poursuivez avec l'Acte de contrition.)

name: Novena al Sacro Cuore di Gesù
content:
O Cuore santissimo di Gesù, fonte di ogni benedizione, io Ti adoro, Ti amo, e con vivo dolore dei miei peccati Ti offro questo povero cuore.
Rendimi umile, paziente, puro e pienamente ubbidiente alla Tua volontà.
Concedi, buon Gesù, che io viva in Te e per Te.
Proteggimi in mezzo ai pericoli; consolami nelle mie afflizioni;
dammi salute del corpo, aiuto nelle mie necessità temporali,
la Tua benedizione su tutto ciò che faccio, e la grazia di una morte santa.

Cuore Sacro di Gesù, confido in Te.

(Ripeti questa preghiera della novena una volta al giorno per nove giorni consecutivi, chiedendo una grazia particolare, e concludi con un Padre Nostro, un'Ave Maria e un Gloria al Padre.)
Amen.

name: Lectio Divina — Pregare con la Scrittura
content:
La Lectio Divina, «lettura divina», è un antico modo di pregare con la Sacra Scrittura in quattro passi semplici. Scegli un breve brano del Vangelo e procedi lentamente in ogni passo.

1. LECTIO — Leggi
Leggi il brano lentamente, ad alta voce se puoi. Lascia che le parole si depositino senza affrettarti alla riga successiva.

2. MEDITATIO — Medita
Rileggi il brano. Nota la parola o la frase che rimane con te. Fermati su di essa. Cosa ti dice Dio attraverso di essa?

3. ORATIO — Prega
Rispondi a Dio con le tue parole — gratitudine, dolore, una domanda, un desiderio — così come sorge nel tuo cuore.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Contempla
Metti da parte le parole e riposa semplicemente nella presenza di Dio.

«Fermatevi e sappiate che io sono Dio.» — Salmo 46, 11

name: Esame di Coscienza
content:
Prima della Confessione, o come preghiera silenziosa alla fine della giornata, esamina la tua coscienza alla presenza dell'amore e della misericordia di Dio.

• Ho messo Dio al primo posto oggi — nei miei pensieri, nelle mie parole, nel mio tempo?
• Ho pregato, o ho lasciato che la giornata soffocasse la preghiera?
• Ho onorato i miei genitori, la mia famiglia e chi ha autorità su di me?
• Ho ferito qualcuno con rabbia, parole dure o trascuratezza?
• Sono stato onesto, o ho mentito, spettegolato o giudicato ingiustamente qualcuno?
• Sono stato fedele e puro nelle mie relazioni e nei miei pensieri?
• Ho preso ciò che non era mio, o sono stato ingrato per ciò che ho?
• Ho invidiato gli altri, o ho confidato in ciò che Dio mi ha dato?

Signore, per ciò che ho fatto e per ciò che ho omesso di fare, chiedo perdono. Aiutami ad amare Te e il mio prossimo più fedelmente domani.

(Prosegui con l'Atto di Dolore.)

name: Novena ao Sagrado Coração de Jesus
content:
Ó Sacratíssimo Coração de Jesus, fonte de toda bênção, eu Vos adoro, eu Vos amo, e com vivo pesar dos meus pecados ofereço-Vos este pobre coração.
Fazei-me humilde, paciente, puro e inteiramente obediente à Vossa vontade.
Concedei, bom Jesus, que eu viva em Vós e para Vós.
Protegei-me em meio ao perigo; confortai-me nas minhas aflições;
dai-me saúde do corpo, auxílio nas minhas necessidades temporais,
a Vossa bênção em tudo o que faço, e a graça de uma santa morte.

Coração Sagrado de Jesus, em Vós confio.

(Repita esta oração da novena uma vez por dia durante nove dias seguidos, pedindo uma graça especial, e conclua com um Pai Nosso, uma Ave Maria e um Glória ao Pai.)
Amém.

name: Lectio Divina — Orar com a Escritura
content:
A Lectio Divina, «leitura divina», é uma forma antiga de orar com a Sagrada Escritura em quatro passos simples. Escolha uma breve passagem do Evangelho e avance devagar por cada passo.

1. LECTIO — Ler
Leia a passagem devagar, em voz alta se puder. Deixe as palavras assentarem sem se apressar para a linha seguinte.

2. MEDITATIO — Meditar
Leia a passagem novamente. Repare na palavra ou frase que permanece consigo. Detenha-se nela. O que Deus lhe diz através dela?

3. ORATIO — Orar
Responda a Deus com as suas próprias palavras — gratidão, arrependimento, uma pergunta, um desejo — conforme surgir no seu coração.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Contemplar
Deixe as palavras de lado e simplesmente repouse na presença de Deus.

«Aquietai-vos e sabei que Eu sou Deus.» — Salmo 46, 11

name: Exame de Consciência
content:
Antes da Confissão, ou como oração silenciosa no fim do dia, examine a sua consciência na presença do amor e da misericórdia de Deus.

• Coloquei Deus em primeiro lugar hoje — nos meus pensamentos, nas minhas palavras, no meu tempo?
• Orei, ou deixei que o dia afastasse a oração?
• Honrei os meus pais, a minha família e aqueles que têm autoridade sobre mim?
• Feri alguém com raiva, palavras ásperas ou negligência?
• Fui honesto, ou menti, fofoquei ou julguei alguém injustamente?
• Fui fiel e puro nas minhas relações e nos meus pensamentos?
• Tomei o que não era meu, ou fui ingrato pelo que tenho?
• Tive inveja dos outros, ou confiei no que Deus me deu?

Senhor, pelo que fiz e pelo que deixei de fazer, peço perdão. Ajudai-me a amar-Vos, a Vós e ao meu próximo, com mais fidelidade amanhã.

(Continue com o Ato de Contrição.)

name: Nowenna do Najświętszego Serca Jezusowego
content:
O Najświętsze Serce Jezusa, źródło wszelkiego błogosławieństwa, uwielbiam Cię, kocham Cię i z żywym żalem za moje grzechy ofiaruję Ci to biedne serce moje.
Uczyń mnie pokornym, cierpliwym, czystym i całkowicie posłusznym Twojej woli.
Spraw, dobry Jezu, abym żył w Tobie i dla Ciebie.
Chroń mnie pośród niebezpieczeństw; pociesz mnie w moich utrapieniach;
daj mi zdrowie ciała, pomoc w moich doczesnych potrzebach,
Twoje błogosławieństwo we wszystkim, co czynię, i łaskę świętej śmierci.

Serce Jezusa, Tobie ufam.

(Powtarzaj tę modlitwę nowenny raz dziennie przez dziewięć kolejnych dni, prosząc o określoną łaskę, i zakończ modlitwą Ojcze Nasz, Zdrowaś Maryjo i Chwała Ojcu.)
Amen.

name: Lectio Divina — Modlitwa Pismem Świętym
content:
Lectio Divina, czyli „święte czytanie", to starożytny sposób modlitwy Pismem Świętym w czterech prostych krokach. Wybierz krótki fragment Ewangelii i przechodź powoli przez każdy krok.

1. LECTIO — Czytaj
Czytaj fragment powoli, jeśli możesz, na głos. Pozwól, by słowa osiadły w tobie, nie śpiesz się do następnej linijki.

2. MEDITATIO — Rozważaj
Przeczytaj fragment ponownie. Zwróć uwagę na słowo lub zdanie, które w tobie pozostaje. Zatrzymaj się przy nim. Co Bóg mówi ci przez nie?

3. ORATIO — Módl się
Odpowiedz Bogu własnymi słowami — wdzięcznością, żalem, pytaniem, pragnieniem — tak jak rodzi się to w twoim sercu.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Trwaj w ciszy
Odłóż słowa na bok i po prostu spocznij w obecności Boga.

„Uciszcie się i poznajcie, że Ja jestem Bogiem." — Psalm 46, 11

name: Rachunek Sumienia
content:
Przed spowiedzią, albo jako cicha modlitwa na koniec dnia, zbadaj swoje sumienie w obecności miłości i miłosierdzia Bożego.

• Czy dzisiaj postawiłem Boga na pierwszym miejscu — w myślach, słowach, w moim czasie?
• Czy się modliłem, czy pozwoliłem, aby dzień wyparł modlitwę?
• Czy uszanowałem rodziców, rodzinę i tych, którzy mają nade mną władzę?
• Czy zraniłem kogoś gniewem, niedobrym słowem lub zaniedbaniem?
• Czy byłem szczery, czy skłamałem, plotkowałem lub niesprawiedliwie kogoś osądziłem?
• Czy byłem wierny i czysty w moich relacjach i myślach?
• Czy wziąłem coś, co nie było moje, albo czy byłem niewdzięczny za to, co mam?
• Czy zazdrościłem innym, czy zaufałem temu, co dał mi Bóg?

Panie, za to, co uczyniłem, i za to, czego zaniedbałem, przepraszam. Pomóż mi jutro wierniej kochać Ciebie i bliźniego.

(Kontynuuj Aktem Żalu.)

name: نوفينا (تساعية) لقلب يسوع الأقدس
content:
أيها القلب الأقدس ليسوع، ينبوع كل بركة، إني أسجد لك وأحبك، وبندم صادق على خطاياي أقدّم لك هذا القلب الفقير.
اجعلني متواضعًا، صبورًا، طاهرًا، وخاضعًا كليًا لإرادتك.
امنحني أيها الصالح يسوع أن أحيا فيك ولك.
احمني وسط الأخطار، وعزِّني في ضيقاتي،
وامنحني الصحة في جسدي، والعون في احتياجاتي الزمنية،
وبركتك على كل ما أعمله، ونعمة الموت المقدس.

يا قلب يسوع الأقدس، عليك اتكالي.

(كرِّر هذه الصلاة مرة كل يوم لمدة تسعة أيام متتالية، طالبًا نعمة معينة، واختمها بصلاة أبانا والسلام عليك يا مريم والمجد للآب.)

name: لكتيو ديفينا — الصلاة بكلمة الله
content:
لكتيو ديفينا، أي «القراءة المقدسة»، هي طريقة قديمة للصلاة بالكتاب المقدس في أربع خطوات بسيطة. اختر مقطعًا إنجيليًا قصيرًا وتقدّم ببطء عبر كل خطوة.

١. ليكتيو — اقرأ
اقرأ المقطع ببطء، وبصوت مسموع إن أمكن. دع الكلمات تستقر فيك دون التسرع إلى السطر التالي.

٢. ميديتاتسيو — تأمّل
أعد قراءة المقطع. لاحظ الكلمة أو العبارة التي تبقى معك. توقف عندها. ماذا يقول لك الله من خلالها؟

٣. أوراتسيو — صلِّ
جاوب الله بكلماتك الخاصة — شكرًا أو ندمًا أو سؤالًا أو رغبة — كما ينبع من قلبك.

٤. كونتمبلاتسيو — تأمّل بصمت
ضع الكلمات جانبًا واسترح ببساطة في حضرة الله.

«كُفُّوا واعلموا أني أنا الله.» — مزمور ٤٦: ١١

name: فحص الضمير
content:
قبل الاعتراف، أو كصلاة هادئة في نهاية اليوم، افحص ضميرك في حضرة محبة الله ورحمته.

• هل وضعت الله أولًا اليوم — في أفكاري، وكلماتي، ووقتي؟
• هل صلّيت، أم تركت اليوم يزاحم الصلاة؟
• هل أكرمت والديّ وعائلتي ومن لهم سلطة عليّ؟
• هل جرحت أحدًا بالغضب أو الكلام القاسي أو الإهمال؟
• هل كنت صادقًا، أم كذبت أو اغتبت أو حكمت على أحد ظلمًا؟
• هل كنت أمينًا وطاهرًا في علاقاتي وأفكاري؟
• هل أخذت ما ليس لي، أم كنت جاحدًا لما أملك؟
• هل حسدت الآخرين، أم وثقت بما أعطاني الله؟

يا رب، عمّا فعلته وعمّا قصّرت فيه، أنا آسف. أعنّي على أن أحبك وأحب قريبي بأمانة أكبر غدًا.

(تابع بصلاة الندامة.)

name: Novena sa Kabanal-banalang Puso ni Hesus
content:
O Kabanal-banalang Puso ni Hesus, bukal ng bawat pagpapala, sinasamba kita, mahal kita, at dala ng taos-pusong pagsisisi sa aking mga kasalanan, iniaalay ko sa iyo itong dukhang puso ko.
Gawin mo akong mapagpakumbaba, matiyaga, malinis, at lubos na masunurin sa iyong kalooban.
Ipagkaloob mo, mabuting Hesus, na mabuhay ako sa iyo at para sa iyo.
Ingatan mo ako sa gitna ng panganib; aliwin mo ako sa aking mga paghihirap;
bigyan mo ako ng kalusugan ng katawan, tulong sa aking pang-araw-araw na pangangailangan,
ang iyong pagpapala sa lahat ng aking ginagawa, at ang biyaya ng banal na kamatayan.

Banal na Puso ni Hesus, sa iyo ko inilalagay ang aking buong pagtitiwala.

(Ulitin ang panalanging novena na ito isang beses kada araw sa loob ng siyam na magkakasunod na araw, hinihiling ang isang natatanging kahilingan, at tapusin ng isang Ama Namin, Aba Ginoong Maria, at Luwalhati sa Ama.)
Amen.

name: Lectio Divina — Pananalangin sa Kasulatan
content:
Ang Lectio Divina, o «banal na pagbasa», ay isang sinaunang paraan ng pananalangin sa Banal na Kasulatan sa apat na simpleng hakbang. Pumili ng maikling talata mula sa Ebanghelyo at dahan-dahang tahakin ang bawat hakbang.

1. LECTIO — Basahin
Basahin ang talata nang dahan-dahan, nang malakas kung maaari. Hayaang mapasakin ang mga salita nang hindi nagmamadali sa susunod na linya.

2. MEDITATIO — Bulay-bulayin
Basahing muli ang talata. Pansinin ang salita o pariralang nananatili sa iyo. Manatili rito. Ano ang sinasabi sa iyo ng Diyos sa pamamagitan nito?

3. ORATIO — Manalangin
Sagutin ang Diyos sa sarili mong mga salita — pasasalamat, pagsisisi, isang tanong, isang pananabik — kung paano ito bumangon sa iyong puso.

4. CONTEMPLATIO — Manahimik
Ilagay sa tabi ang mga salita at magpahinga lamang sa presensya ng Diyos.

«Tumahimik kayo, at kilalanin ninyo na ako ang Diyos.» — Awit 46:11

name: Pagsusuri ng Budhi
content:
Bago ang Kumpisal, o bilang tahimik na panalangin sa pagtatapos ng araw, suriin ang iyong budhi sa harap ng pag-ibig at awa ng Diyos.

• Inuna ko ba ang Diyos ngayon — sa aking mga iniisip, sinasabi, at oras?
• Nanalangin ba ako, o hinayaan kong maisantabi ng araw ang panalangin?
• Iginalang ko ba ang aking mga magulang, pamilya, at mga nasa ibabaw ko?
• May nasaktan ba ako dahil sa galit, malupit na salita, o kapabayaan?
• Naging matapat ba ako, o nagsinungaling, tumsismis, o hinatulan nang hindi makatarungan ang iba?
• Naging tapat ba ako at malinis sa aking mga relasyon at kaisipan?
• Kumuha ba ako ng hindi akin, o naging walang utang-na-loob sa mayroon ako?
• Nainggit ba ako sa iba, o nagtiwala sa ibinigay sa akin ng Diyos?

Panginoon, sa aking mga ginawa at hindi nagawa, humihingi ako ng patawad. Tulungan mo akong mahalin ka, at ang aking kapwa, nang higit na tapat bukas.

(Ipagpatuloy sa Panalangin ng Pagsisisi.)

name: Nicene Creed (Eastern Orthodox Text)
content:
I believe in one God,
the Father almighty,
maker of heaven and earth,
of all things visible and invisible.
I believe in one Lord Jesus Christ,
the Only Begotten Son of God,
born of the Father before all ages.
God from God, Light from Light,
true God from true God,
begotten, not made, consubstantial with the Father;
through him all things were made.
For us men and for our salvation
he came down from heaven,
and by the Holy Spirit was incarnate of the Virgin Mary,
and became man.
For our sake he was crucified under Pontius Pilate,
he suffered death and was buried,
and rose again on the third day
in accordance with the Scriptures.
He ascended into heaven
and is seated at the right hand of the Father.
He will come again in glory
to judge the living and the dead
and his kingdom will have no end.
I believe in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the giver of life,
who proceeds from the Father,
who with the Father and the Son is adored and glorified,
who has spoken through the prophets.
I believe in one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church.
I confess one Baptism for the forgiveness of sins
and I look forward to the resurrection of the dead
and the life of the world to come.
Amen.

name: Trisagion Prayers (The Usual Beginning)
content:
O Heavenly King, Comforter, Spirit of Truth, Who art everywhere present and fillest all things, Treasury of good things and Giver of life: come and abide in us, cleanse us from every stain, and save our souls, O Good One.

Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us. (three times)

Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

All-holy Trinity, have mercy on us. Lord, cleanse us from our sins. Master, pardon our iniquities. Holy God, visit and heal our infirmities for Thy name's sake.

Lord, have mercy. (three times)

Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

Our Father, Who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

For Thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

name: Prayer of the Optina Elders
content:
